name: core-runtime-namespace-variable-precedence-api67

source.content: public class Database { public String query(String soql) { return 'local'; } }

@isTest private class NamespaceVariablePrecedenceTest { @isTest static void localVariableWins() { Database Database = new Database(); System.assertEquals('local', Database.query('SELECT Name FROM Account')); } }

evidence.notes: The local variable named Database resolves before the local Database class and System.Database namespace.
